macros.name: atallowdigits
macros.doc: The \atallowdigits command allows digits to be used as letters; \atdisallowdigits prevents this.

macros.name: atdisallowdigits
macros.doc: The \atallowdigits command allows digits to be used as letters; \atdisallowdigits prevents this.

macros.name: newatcommand
macros.doc: The \newatcommand command will define a new @-command using a syntax similar to \newcommand.

macros.name: renewatcommand
macros.doc: A \renewatcommand is also provided to redefine existing commands, should the need arise.
